stage_rules.approach: Each consumed approach GO needs own base GT within 0.12 m / 15 deg of static prestation; nearest subsequent trace <=50.35 ms.
stage_rules.joint_grasp: Both fingers of BOTH robots >=1 N continuously 0.2 SIM s.
stage_rules.lift: All eight beam box corners >=0.04 m above floor AND joint grasp continuously 0.2 SIM s.
stage_rules.door: Whole beam previously west of slab x[2.175,2.225]; every slab-overlap sample stays in y[-0.18,0.28] and has lift/grip unless an authorized planned set-down. Then ALL corners must be east of x=2.225 with both controllers carrying, every finger >=1 N and bottom >=0.04 m continuously 0.2 SIM s. Center x=2.40 alone is not passage.
stage_rules.placement_release: After door passage, final 1 s: full projected beam footprint inside B + 0.02 m tolerance; bottom [-0.005,0.01], tilt<=10 deg, every finger<0.2 N, speed<=0.02 m/s; both controllers done. B width equals 0.60 m beam length: 2 cm tolerance is explicit dev only.
stage_rules.drop: After first lift, loss of joint grasp fails unless the beam is currently floor-supported within an authorized planned set-down. Bottom<0.01 m outside that set-down fails. Confirmed re-lift closes that segment's exemption even before the next carry GO; later landing/recontact cannot reopen it or erase earlier failures. Tilt>15 deg or penetration>0.005 m always fails, including during planned set-down. No blanket exemption by state name; failed/abort never exempts.
stage_rules.contacts: Every 0.25 ms physics step: penetrating contact with normal force>1e-6 N; robot-robot, robot-wall, beam-wall, pre-align robot-beam and r3-to-participant/cargo must all be zero. Normal finger grip and floor support permitted.
stage_rules.go: First consumption of every seen phase/segment GO by r1/r2 at same SIM timestamp (1e-8 tolerance); nominal requires approach@0 plus lift/carry/lower/open for every planned segment.
stage_rules.abort: Inspect retained endpoint arm/carry/port queues, host macro/capture queue and actual port interpolation/motors after STATUS abort. All empty/stopped; zero arm/look/drive/mecanum commands even later in same SIM instant. Observe >=0.5 SIM s after abort.
stage_rules.video: Manual named reviewer must approve all stages, tied to run_id and exact trace/video SHA256; absent review cannot pass.
stage_rules.completion: PAIR_SEQUENCE_DONE/unconfirmed is only executor sequence evidence. No GT-derived result is sent back to actors.
stage_rules.coverage: Trace first and final samples match manifest.simulator_start_s and sim_end_s within 1e-7 s; strictly increasing, <=50.35 ms gaps, all on the applied 0.25 ms grid. Contact observation covers the same endpoints, counts exactly round((end-start)/dt) physics intervals (initial observation is not a step), max step gap matches dt and invalid intervals=0. Missing metadata/prefix/tail/step is EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE; includes abort diagnostics.
stage_rules.prereg_integrity: Before any scoring, SHA256 of the exact saved prereg.json bytes must equal original manifest.prereg.sha256. Missing/mismatched hash is EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE. Prepare copies bytes unchanged; no post-run reformatting or rebinding.
stage_rules.host_error: An explicit manifest host_error or state=host_error is HOST_ERROR with its original cause, even without pair route/trace/video. No physical scoring; prereg integrity and absent evidence are reported separately. ENOSPC remains HOST_ERROR.
stage_rules.admission_diagnostics: Before scoring, every refused pair_carry API action_id must have exactly one eval_only/pair_admission.jsonl receipt. Missing receipt is DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE, never proof of a different cause. Keep the 60 s one-shot submission unless a coordinator-approved fresh prereg explicitly changes it.

failure_classification.ENOSPC: HOST_ERROR; retain partial artifacts and managed console log, do not count as controller failure or silently retry
failure_classification.host_error: HOST_ERROR with original manifest cause; no physical scoring; prereg integrity and missing evidence reported separately
failure_classification.SELF_UNCERTAIN: Inspect failed_checks and gate state/thresholds/dwell in the private receipt; tag age explains estimator behavior but is not an admission predicate.
failure_classification.SWEEP_TRANSITION_BLOCKED: Preserve exact own estimate/PWM/static-map guard diagnostics; distinguish positive raw clearance from negative uncertainty-inflated clearance. No automatic retreat through an uncertified starting footprint.

evidence.tensorboard: After coordinator execution: convert each completed/retrieved success/failure into a NEW native TensorBoard snapshot per docs/tensorboard.md, including video hash/registration/loading. No physical result or new snapshot exists for this registration.

planned_setdown.decision: Keep the frozen M2 checkpoints including beam center x=2.40 m. Classify authorized checkpoint set-down separately from unplanned drops; it is not door passage.
planned_setdown.basis: run_m2_pair.py M2DoorStudent: dev 801/802 open-loop yaw drift 0.06-0.1 rad/m over 2.2 m, held view shows only beam. Lower/open/relocalize/regrasp preserves the short carry cadence; v3 uses stored grip. docs/zone_m2_pair.md defines own-camera M2 reuse. No physical validation is inherited.
planned_setdown.authorization: Both robots consume the same lower GO for segment i. Until both consume carry GO for i+1: lower/wait_open/cp_open in i, or pregrasp_look/grasp/wait_lift/lift/wait_carry in i+1. Last segment instead permits lower/wait_open/released/done through the end. Segments and states are evaluation-only controller metadata.
planned_setdown.geometry: Beam center must remain within 0.12 m of the preregistered static endpoint. This is an explicit dev tolerance, not a measured accuracy claim. Tilt >15 deg, floor penetration >5 mm and forbidden contacts are never exempt. Door y bounds always apply in the slab.
planned_setdown.floor_support: All eight box corners must be within the existing floor_penetration_tolerance_m/release_bottom_m bands around their floor-rest heights (lower face zero, upper face one beam thickness). Thickness is the length of a local vertical box edge in the ordered trace, not the world-Z extent. Each corner's absolute vertical displacement divided by the preceding trace interval must be <=release_speed_m_s; a missing, nonpositive or over-max_sample_gap_s interval cannot establish support. Joint grasp is required at every unsupported sample, including lowering and re-lifting.
planned_setdown.relift: After floor support has been observed in a segment's authorized window, joint grasp with all corners >=lift_bottom_m continuously for lift_dwell_s closes that window's exemption permanently. Use the existing lift and sample-gap criteria, independent of next carry GO or controller claims.
planned_setdown.scope: Low height is allowed during authorized lowering with joint grasp; released fingers require current floor support. After confirmed re-lift, neither grip loss nor low height is exempt, even if the beam settles again before carry GO. Missing authorization, wrong segment, one robot carrying, off-target lowering, failed/abort and post-carry-GO drops are not planned set-down.
